title: REQ · Send is disabled when text is blank, over limit, quota is exhausted or a send is in flight
summary: Send button disabled state covers all invalid, empty, quota-exhausted and in-flight conditions.
description: Context: ContributionSheet Send is disabled only at zero quota. Desired behavior: disabled whenever trimmed text is empty, length exceeds MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH, remaining <= 0, or a submission is pending. Expected result: no click can start an invalid or duplicate submission. Why: prevents invalid and double submits.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty or whitespace-only text, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.
Given text longer than MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.
Given remaining quota is 0, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.
Given a submission whose promise has not settled, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.

preserve: handleSubmit guards for blank, over limit and quota

technical_constraints: handleSubmit keeps its own guards because the form can be submitted with Enter or programmatically
definition_of_done: Send disabled in all four conditions and enabled for valid text with quota
